summary: Targeted regression for AddWidgetPicker race-condition fix (iter 44 follow-up). All three scenarios PASS end-to-end via Playwright on the public preview URL. The split-useEffect + AbortController refactor in Profile.jsx successfully eliminates the viewer-hydration race that was previously dropping setAvailable/setDisabledKeys results.

scenario_1_stealth_disabled_radar.banner_text: 1 widget currently disabled by an admin and hidden from this picker. Manage at /admin/widgets.

scenario_2_tftwo_non_admin.result: PASS — non-admin correctly sees filtered widget list AND no admin banner

scenario_3_stealth_restore_radar.result: PASS — disable→launch round-trip works and banner clears when disabledKeys.size becomes 0

scenario_4_regression_sanity.comment: 16-tile grid renders cleanly for stealth after restore; Cancel and Add Selected buttons present and enabled. Multi-select UX visually intact (data-testid=add-widget-{key} on every tile).

critical_code_review_comments: Fix in Profile.jsx (lines 209-251) is clean: two independent useEffects, each with its own AbortController. Effect #1 depends only on [open] so it can't be re-triggered by viewer hydration. Effect #2 is gated on [open, viewer] and the AbortController only aborts the in-flight request — the resolved setDisabledKeys is no longer silently swallowed by a stale `cancelled` flag.

Admin check at line 237-238 still hard-codes username==='stealth' as a fallback. Belt-and-braces, but for a renamed founder this would lose the banner. Recommend prefer viewer.is_admin / viewer.role over the username override (non-blocking; iter 44 already noted).
Picker correctly falls through to WIDGET_TYPES only when /widgets/available returns empty or errors non-abort; this preserves the offline-friendly UX without re-introducing the disabled-widget leak.

rca of the issue: Already documented in iter 44. Verified mitigation here: separating /widgets/available and /widgets/disabled into independent effects + replacing the boolean `cancelled` flag with AbortController eliminates the dropped-setState race when viewer hydrates asynchronously after the picker mounts.
